Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH team,

You set out the cost pressures in detail; it sounds like protecting a sustainable margin is central to this renewal. We value our long-term relationship and want to support it with dependable purchasing commitments. How can a longer agreement help us find a workable balance on payment and price?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,580 units per year for 24 months. Producer prices DE: electronic components changed -2.3% from 2025-01 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C2611@2025-01, idx:PPI-C2611@2025-10). Our demand forecast for Frequency converter 7.5 kW is up +10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 430.81 per unit, 90 days payment, 24 months, 4,580 units a year). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your e-mail, which we have reviewed internally.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €432.44 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.
Please note:
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
As to the index change and volume change data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length.
CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost. That remains.
We welcome your commitment to a 24-month contract, which provides mutual planning security and allows us to adjust our pricing.
We have verified the PPI-C2611 index development and factored it into our calculation.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net: €430.97 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION.
Should you require further information, please let us know.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH team,

You welcome a longer commitment while directing the discussion toward terms rather than price; it sounds like predictable business is the route forward. We want a lasting agreement that supports reliable planning for both sides. How can we use that shared interest to conclude the renewal within your stated constraints?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,580 units per year for 24 months. Copper notation for cables and motors (derived) changed -2.2% from 2026-01 to 2026-03 (idx:CU-NOTATION@2026-01, idx:CU-NOTATION@2026-03). Our recent orders for Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 were at 412.74 per 1 (po:4500014351-10, po:4500014417-10, po:4500014465-10).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 431.54 per unit, 90 days payment, 24 months, 4,580 units a year). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. That remains. CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. 

Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. As our management has frozen price reductions, we can only make a minor adjustment to €432.39 per unit for the 90-day payment term. To achieve a lower price, we would need to adjust the payment terms.

Our Angebot comprises a price of €432.39 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. This quote is valid for 30 days. Our standard terms apply to everything the quote does not state; see attached.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
